rule: Below 20 mi/week the long run may be up to 40% of weekly miles.
summary: An arithmetic accommodation (DECISIONS 10): with 3 runs at 10-12 mi/week a 30% cap is unworkable. No evidence addresses the share itself; injury risk tracks the single run's length vs the 30-day longest, which the spike cap controls regardless of this fraction. Keep as a heuristic.

sources.note: The protective constraint is the single-run spike (>10% over 30-day longest), already enforced separately
